name: Allianz Arena
features: volume wrapped around the playing field
translation: Preserve the central field opening. Arrange curved perimeter segments around seating and a separate inward-projecting canopy. Suggest the inflated skin with rounded parts; never a single closed solid.

name: Aqua Tower
features: balcony shapes vary from floor to floor
translation: Place thin offset balcony plates at several levels around a continuous glass core, varying plate width and depth. Rounded plates approximate the wavy outline; spacing is a simplified conceptual sample of floors.

name: Burj Khalifa
translation: Arrange three radial wings around a central shaft. Shorten and narrow wings at successive tiers, then add a thin spire. Keep all tiers supported.

name: Habitat 67
features: private garden space for each dwelling
translation: Stack offset dwelling boxes in supported clusters, leaving roof terraces exposed. Use several levels and separate clusters, not a single tower. Module dimensions are design assumptions unless supplied.

name: One World Trade Center
features: chamfered edges form eight elongated triangular facets
translation: Keep a square base, then progressively alter the upper footprint to suggest the chamfered faceted silhouette. Primitive tiers approximate the continuous facets; do not claim an exact replica.

name: Sky Habitat
translation: Compose stepped residential blocks with continuous supports and elevated connecting garden platforms. Leave gaps for light and air; represent terraces as outdoor plates, not solid rooms.

name: SoFi Stadium
features: landscape and water integrated around the venue
translation: Use stepped stands around an empty central field, a broad thin curved canopy above them, and separate landscape/water parts. A flattened ellipsoid only approximates the canopy; never fill the field with a solid cylinder.

name: Taipei 101
translation: Use repeated tier groups with projecting upper rims above a wider base. Stack groups continuously and add the narrow crown; do not produce a plain rectangular shaft.

name: Valley
features: jagged floors with cantilevers and setbacks
translation: Use three unequal towers on a connected base. Offset stepped volumes and balcony plates toward a shared open valley. Add small terrace planting volumes without filling the central opening.
